native_retrieval.snippet: An official website of the United States government Here's how you know. A **.mil** website belongs to an official U.S. Department of Defense organization in the United States. ## Congratulations on your assignment to the 82nd Airborne Division! As the only conventional force who can deploy a Brigade Combat Team in 96 hours, the Nation expects us to be ready. This page is intended to help address the most common questions we get when Soldiers and Families arrive, as well as help you set expectations for your first couple of weeks on the ground. We look forward to your arrival and welcoming you to the Army’s ONLY Airborne Division. * All Soldiers in the rank of SSG and below, and all 2LTs, will have an NCO contact you as you get closer to your report date. Because of the operational readiness cycle of the 82nd Airborne Division, it is common for enlisted Paratroopers to be diverted to the Brigade with the greatest need for their MOS and grade.
